title: Rogues' Quarter
wikitext:
[[Image:Rogues' Quarter.jpg|thumb|Rogues' Quarter]]
The '''Rogues' Quarter''' is located in the southeastern corner of the [[Undercity]]. It is home to many of the [[Forsaken|Forsaken's]] more shady characters, the rogues' guild, and a few profession trainers.

Facilities:
* [[Rogue]] trainers.
* [[Poison]] vendor
* [[Leatherworking]] trainers
* [[Skinning]] trainers
* [[Engineering]] trainers
* [[First Aid]] trainers
